return_source_hypothesis: The report proposes that unstable conditional excess momentum (PF) and heterogeneous volume-delimited episode returns (VV) reflect short-lived overreaction. If that conjecture is true, lower detector instability should rank better future returns. I retain a mixed behavioral/market-friction hypothesis, not an established risk premium: the same measured close/open/vol paths could reflect permanent information or ordinary low-volatility/liquidity/size exposures. Positive IC is a test of the fixed ranking prediction, not evidence selecting the economic story from these rivals.
expected_failure_regimes: Higher-volatility/liquidity-stress or sparse-observation conditions may create the score without temporary overreaction.
The raw score may have different meaning in persistent-information episodes than in temporary-pressure episodes.
Long recovery and stale carried valuations can make apparent numeric completeness economically fragile.

formula_components.mechanism_requirement: Lower PF is preferred. The daily sum retains selected excess movement; the outer SD deletes daily level/direction. The skew>0 gate itself is asymmetric, so the complete PF construction is not globally sign-invariant.
formula_components.state_interpretation: Conditional same-sign excess momentum variability under the author's right-skewed cross-section gate; not the number of bullish traders.

formula_components.mechanism_requirement: Lower VV is preferred. Volume peaks define boundaries, not volume participation ratios. Unequal segment lengths and sparse prices can mimic this variability; CS normalization before TS SD cannot be commuted.
formula_components.state_interpretation: Author-hypothesized heterogeneous episode price impacts observed through volume-peak partitions; no emotion labels are observed.

formula_components.mechanism_requirement: A fixed source-family ranking, not a sufficient statistic for latent mispricing. Equal weighting discards the PF/VV vector and does not establish a nonlinear interaction or causal component contribution.
formula_components.state_interpretation: Joint relative stability of the two report detectors on a common finite cross-section.

reusable_operator.observation_mapping: Completed-day returns and volume -> same-sign deviation/skew gate daily PF accumulator and volume-peak partition return SD daily VV -> daily VV cross-sectional z-score -> full-calendar 20-day SD -> common-universe component z-scores -> negative equal-weight score.

return_source_hypothesis: 原经济思路是成交量脉冲伴随短暂订单压力和注意力追涨，价格偏离随后衰减。冻结 EVENT_U 把这一思路转成低U优先的多头假说，但 sign(r_e) 与绝对值归一化同时消去了冲击方向。上涨过度反应和下跌过度反应不能无条件映射成同一负向未来收益，当前证据不支持该额外桥接假设。
mathematical_object: measured_object_{i,t} = S(i,t), the day-t negative cross-sectional standardized unsigned residual event displacement U(i,t)

formula_components.mechanism_requirement: 缩小到可能发生短暂冲击的局部路径，保留事件时间但会漏掉小而持续的冲击。
formula_components.state_interpretation: 异常交易参与的候选时点，不等于已识别的非理性订单或新闻事件。

formula_components.mechanism_requirement: q_e<0 表示事件后反向运动；h=0 的绝对收益不被当作反转证据。
formula_components.state_interpretation: 冲击后日内延续或反转的实现路径，并非未来20日的条件收益。

formula_components.mechanism_requirement: 保留相对幅度，丢失冲击方向；正部截断把完全反转事件与无事件合并为0，微小分母可放大数值。
formula_components.state_interpretation: 标准化的未反转幅度代理，而非有方向的价格高估。

formula_components.mechanism_requirement: 预期高S取得较好未来相对收益；最高五分位含所有边界并列值，实际平均入选61.11%，不能称集中20%组合。
formula_components.state_interpretation: 低U股票优先级，并不补回U已丢失的方向信息。

reusable_operator.observation_mapping: measured_object_{i,t}=S(i,t)=-robust_z_cs(U(i,t)); direct-code EVENT_U uses only day-t completed minute paths and strictly earlier volume baselines; no event yields U=0, invalid coverage is missing. beta>0 was the tested predictive hypothesis and is not asserted as identified.

reuse_constraints: Only reuse as same-factor evidence when artifact_identity matches.
Use as similar-case analogy when factor/report/branch/run identity differs.
Never transfer the EVENT_U rejection to source PF/VV or the equal-weight source composite.
Operator properties and historical analogies suggest tests; they do not identify the cause of this study's return or authorize tuning.

success_patterns: EVENT_U local IS raw Rank IC was positive (mean 0.0229772409); this is an observed ordering diagnostic, not source PF/VV reproduction or proof of incremental tradable alpha.
failure_patterns: Scope: rejected EVENT_U extension only. Source PF, VV and their equal-weight composite were not evaluated in this study.
Observed local IS net CAGR=-0.0407762519539, Sharpe=-0.09774389326117279, maximum drawdown=-0.5637777679470284; the frozen long-only criterion failed. This does not identify a market-regime cause.

The reviewed EVENT_U transformation removes shock direction and merges no-event and fully reversed states at U=0. These are properties of the estimator; their separate causal contribution to realized performance is not identified.
All boundary ties were included: mean selection breadth was 61.113% of finite scores, not a concentrated 20% portfolio.
Full-market incremental signal was unsupported by the existing four-control residual diagnostic. A SMALL size tercile result is not a microcap strategy, OOS or causal confirmation.

Interpretation is limited by 141823 missing execution VWAP records, 70862 stale-price holding days (maximum single-stock run 1006 days), and 4940525 holding days with unknown historical listing status. Missing buys were blocked and blocked sells carried; those rules do not remove valuation uncertainty.
Knowledge lessons are case-scoped interpretations. Style winter, valuation compression and mandate-driven style-premium explanations were unsubstantiated template text and are withdrawn.
